# Vendored from pk-kubb-score

`notation-parser.js` (generated from the Planet Kubb Notation grammar by Peggy),
`canonical.js` (the canonical writer) and `kubb.js` (the reader and scorer) are copies from
pk-kubb-score (`Planet-Kubb/pk-kubb-score`), the home of Planet Kubb Notation. They are a
tagged release, unchanged: `SOURCE` names the tag and its commit (Notation 2, edition
2026.11, tag `v2-2026.11`). The notation gate (`tests/node/notation-gate.mjs`) runs every
game file through them, and the real-games tools count with `kubb.js`.

Do not edit these files here. To take a newer release, run `make sync-notation` with a
pk-kubb-score checkout beside this repository (or at `$PK_KUBB_SCORE`): it copies the files
as they are at the checkout's latest tag (or `PKTAG=<tag>`) and rewrites `SOURCE`. Read the
diff, run `make test` and `make games`, and commit. `package.json` only marks the folder as
ES modules.
